title: Burn ledger event
description: One row in the burn-events DynamoDB table and one item in the dashboard feed. Never contains a raw credential value: only secret_ref and an HMAC fingerprint.

event_id.description: evt_ + ULID. Sorts by time, so /events?since=<event_id> is a plain string comparison.

ts.description: UTC, ISO 8601, millisecond precision, Z suffix.

agent_id.description: The agent this event is about. 'system' for events not tied to one agent.

session_id.description: Badge session that made the call, when known.

source.description: Where Burn saw this. tool_response = post-call interceptor; egress = proxy; handoff = send_message check; burn = Burn API; gateway = pre-call interceptor; session = session start; provider = mock API provider; instance = instance lifecycle (role-based sessions).

action.description: recorded = credential seen in a tool response, added to ledger. blocked = outbound credential stopped. revoked = badge revoked. rotated = credential rotated. flagged = shared/other-owner credential flagged for review. refused = call with a revoked/unknown badge or disallowed tool refused. issued = session/credential issued. inherited = receiver of send_message inherited sender's ledger entry. rejected = provider refused a stale (rotated) key. started / exited = an instance began or ended (source instance). unregistered = a call with a badge Burn never issued was refused (agent_id system). canary_used = a session's canary (a decoy credential that never authenticates) was presented to the mock API provider; agent_id and session_id (the instance) say whose canary it was. dismissed = an owner closed a flagged credential after review, with a reason (the credential was not rotated).

tool.description: MCP tool name, without any gateway target prefix.

secret_ref.description: Secrets Manager name of the credential. null for unknown credentials found by format detectors.

fingerprint.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex of the credential value (see contracts/README.md#fingerprints).

owner.description: agent = owned by one agent (may differ from agent_id; see owner_agent_id). shared = used by several agents. unknown = matched a format detector only.

owner_agent_id.description: When owner = agent, which agent owns the credential.

destination.description: egress: destination host (no path, no query string).

encoding.description: egress/handoff: the transform the detector undid to find the match, e.g. plain, base64, hex, url, reversed, split, multi_request.

detail.description: Short human-readable explanation for the dashboard. Must never contain a credential value.

role.description: Role of the instance this event is about, when it has one.

actor.description: Who caused this: the signed-in person's email, "instance:<session_id>" for an instance acting on its own session, or "system" for Burn itself. null or absent for events written before sign-in.

parent_session.description: Instance events: the session that spawned this instance, if any.

flag_level.description: flagged events: review severity of the credential after this event. seen < attempted < reported; it never decreases.
